# PitTech MCP parity matrix

<!-- GENERATED by scripts/mcp-parity.mjs from contracts/capabilities-v1.json. Do not edit by hand; run `node scripts/mcp-parity.mjs --generate`. -->

Android, iOS and MCP are three maintained interfaces to the same product (issue #114).
Every shipped private capability needs a capability row here: a direct MCP binding, an
explicit device handoff, a documented physical/OS limitation, or a prohibition. The
`Capability parity` CI check fails when the sync contract grows a record type or
definition kind with no declared disposition, when a binding names a symbol that does
not exist in the native sources, when a prohibited capability exposes a tool, or when
this document is stale.

Registry version: 1. MCP status `planned_disabled` means the
binding is designed and contracted but the connector ships disabled; nothing in this
matrix is a claim that MCP is implemented or released.

## Notes per capability

- **community.lookup** — Public reads use the public-only path and live visibility/block/takedown rules. Private save pins exact source revision + credit and creates no public fork, like, or attempt contribution.
- **connection.context** — Distinguish no synced library from an empty one; report the server snapshot time, never a claim of live phone state.
- **device.actions** — Sync-excluded by design: activityTimers, reminderOccurrences, probeAssignments, recordings, preferences. Commands use a closed action enum, a target device, expiry and claim/apply receipts; states are saved / queued_for_device / applied / needs_attention / expired / canceled / failed. Tool names are registered in M6 when the command path lands.
- **equipment.journal** — Journal records only. Cooking hours union overlapping intervals. Never manufacturer credentials, configuration, or grill control — see prohibited.hardware_control.
- **insights.personal** — Raw paged and reduced data are different modes; include algorithm/input version and sample counts. Benchmarks read public-only inputs. M7 ports the merged native calculation engines to a TS adapter pinned to the same fixtures.
- **meals.dishes** — Creating preparation is not Food on. Finish does not require results or saving a recipe. Duplicate setup creates fresh identities without replaying actual history.
- **meals.ingredients_targets_results** — Typed ingredient/target add-update-remove tools plus save_results / save_lessons are finalized in the M0 field inventory. Preserve missing-versus-zero and food-safety versus tenderness targets.
- **meals.log** — Manual readings never masquerade as sensor samples; same-ID manual corrections preserve provenance and note links (landed in #122). Automatic samples stay immutable.
- **media.photos** — Reuse the landed private-photo contract (chunked, hashed, bounded decode). A photo shared by several records is physically removed only when no surviving record needs it.
- **planning.playbooks_guides** — Typed playbook/plan/serve-goal and guide operations are finalized in the M0 field inventory. Show-guide is presentation, not activation.
- **portability.private** — Exports stay private and authenticated; never call publication or relay-upload APIs. History kinds are the Cook Pack / archive mirrors of the same records.
- **preparation.checklists** — Typed combo/checklist operations are finalized in the M0 field inventory. Checking a task does not record a physical cooking action.
- **prohibited.account_security** — Sign-in, grant management, billing, privacy consent, account deletion and credential pairing stay in trusted first-party UI. Readable connection status lives in connection.context.
- **prohibited.hardware_control** — Never ignite, shut down, set temperature, or change fan/auger/Wi-Fi/firmware/configuration. Editing a recorded target or equipment profile is a journal write (equipment.journal), not a command to a grill.
- **prohibited.public_contribution** — No MCP tool or credential authority to publish, revise/unpublish, like, fork publicly, contribute attempts, change a public profile, or moderate. Publishing stays a deliberate in-app action. Android/iOS symbols intentionally empty: the prohibition is the binding.
- **recipes.composition** — Typed preset/collection operations are finalized in the M0 field inventory. Never scale temperatures/times; never silently save every dish as a recipe.
- **recipes.library** — Update creates a new revision with an expected parent; it never rewrites the source meal, old revisions, or an active attempt. Equal-ordinal branches are legal (Room 11); revision UUIDs identify branches.
- **reminders.rules** — Rule definitions sync; occurrences are device-owned. Activation requests route through device.actions, never through a synced enabled flag.

## Deferred projection kinds (no capability surface)

- **unsupported** — Sentinel kind in the projection contract for unsupported authored documents, which stop the projection. It is not a user capability.
